ayahs.1:
**What this ayah teaches:** Stars normally disappear during the day and only appear at night, therefore they are called tariq.

**Classical tafsir:** Ibn Kathir notes: Some of the commentators say that najm refers to the Pleiades or Saturn, and they quote specimens of Arabic speech to confirm their argument.

**From the Sunnah:** At the inception, he was created from various elements collected from throughout the world, and Allah's Power transformed them into a human being who is able to listen and see.

ayahs.3:
**What this ayah teaches:** Stars normally disappear during the day and only appear at night, therefore they are called tariq. The word thaqib means 'piercing brightness'.

**Classical tafsir:** Ibn Kathir notes: Some of the commentators say that najm refers to the Pleiades or Saturn, and they quote specimens of Arabic speech to confirm their argument.

**From the Sunnah:** At the inception, he was created from various elements collected from throughout the world, and Allah's Power transformed them into a human being who is able to listen and see.

ayahs.8:
**Context:** يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ (on a day when all the secrets will be searched out.. 86:9). The word tubla literally means 'to test/examine' and sara'ir means 'secrets'.

**What this ayah teaches:** This is clearly possible, because whoever is able to begin the creation then he surely is able to repeat it.

**Classical tafsir:** Ibn Kathir notes: The word tubla literally means 'to test/examine' and sara'ir means 'secrets'.
ayahs.9:
**Context:** يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ (on a day when all the secrets will be searched out.. 86:9). The word tubla literally means 'to test/examine' and sara'ir means 'secrets'.

**What this ayah teaches:** The word tubla literally means 'to test/examine' and sara'ir means 'secrets'. On the Day of Reckoning, the secrets will be tested and examined and laid bare.

**Classical tafsir:** Ibn Kathir notes: The word tubla literally means 'to test/examine' and sara'ir means 'secrets'.
ayahs.10:
**Context:** يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ (on a day when all the secrets will be searched out.. 86:9). The word tubla literally means 'to test/examine' and sara'ir means 'secrets'.

**What this ayah teaches:** Then he will have no power, nor any helper.) Swearing by the Existence of Humanity surrounded by the Organized System of Allah Allah swears by the heaven and what He has placed in it of radiant stars. The word tubla literally means 'to test/examine' and sara'ir means 'secrets'.

**Classical tafsir:** Ibn Kathir notes: The word tubla literally means 'to test/examine' and sara'ir means 'secrets'.
ayahs.11:
**What this ayah teaches:** By the sky which gives rain, again and again (11)And the earth which splits (12)Verily, this is the Word that separates (13)And it is not a thing for amusement (14)Verily, they are but plotting a plot (15)And I am planning a plan (16)So, give a respite to the those who reject the truth; deal gently with them for a while .

**Classical tafsir:** Ibn Kathir notes: This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
